provider.description: Manages the authorization policy of the Permit.io environment that the API key belongs to.

api_key.description: An environment-level API key for the Permit.io API; the provider manages the environment the key belongs to. Can also be set with the `PERMITIO_API_KEY` environment variable; a value set here takes precedence. The provider needs a key from one of the two.

api_url.description: The base URL of the Permit.io API, an absolute `http` or `https` URL. Defaults to `https://api.permit.io`. Can also be set with the `PERMITIO_API_URL` environment variable; a value set here takes precedence.
validators: value must be an absolute http or https URL

timeout.description: The time limit, in seconds, for each request to the Permit.io API, including its retries after a 429, 502, 503 or 504 response. Must be greater than 0. Defaults to `10`. Can also be set with the `PERMITIO_TIMEOUT` environment variable; a value set here takes precedence.
validators: value must be between 1 and 9223372036

permitio_condition_set_rule.description: Grants a permission to the users in a user set on the resources in a resource set. Every argument forces replacement: changing one removes the rule and creates a new one. See [our documentation](https://api.permit.io/v2/redoc#tag/Condition-Set-Rules) for more information on condition set rules.

organization_id.description: Unique id of the organization that owns the condition set rule
plan_modifiers: stringplanmodifier.useNonNullStateForUnknown: Once set to a non-null value, the value of this attribute in state will not change.

permitio_proxy_config.description: Manages a proxy config: how the Permit Proxy authenticates to a backend service, and which requests to it map to which resource actions. See [the documentation](https://api.permit.io/v2/redoc#tag/Proxy-Config/operation/create_proxy_config) for more information about proxy configs.

auth_mechanism.description:
Enum: "Bearer" "Basic"
Proxy config auth mechanism will define the authentication mechanism that will be used to authenticate the request.

Bearer injects `auth_secret.bearer` into the Authorization header as a Bearer token,

Basic injects `auth_secret.basic` into the Authorization header as a Basic user:password.

Headers, which injects plain headers into the request, is not supported yet: the provider cannot send a Headers secret to the Permit API, so a plan that sets it fails.
validators: auth_mechanism must be Bearer or Basic; Headers is not supported yet

auth_secret.description: Proxy config secret is set to enable the Permit Proxy to make proxied requests to the backend service. Set the attribute that `auth_mechanism` names: `bearer` or `basic`. `headers` is for Headers authentication, which is not supported yet. Its values are sensitive: Terraform hides them in plan output, and an output that references one must be marked `sensitive = true`. Terraform still stores them in plain text in the state. Take them from a variable marked `sensitive = true` rather than writing them in the configuration.

auth_secret.basic.description: The `user:password` the Permit Proxy sends in the Authorization header as Basic credentials. Required when `auth_mechanism` is `Basic`.

auth_secret.bearer.description: The token the Permit Proxy sends in the Authorization header as a Bearer token. Required when `auth_mechanism` is `Bearer`.

auth_secret.headers.description: The headers for Headers authentication, which is not supported yet. Only one of `bearer`, `basic` and `headers` may be set, and `auth_mechanism` needs the one it names, so a configuration cannot use `headers` yet.

environment_id.description: Unique id of the environment that owns the proxy config
plan_modifiers: stringplanmodifier.useNonNullStateForUnknown: Once set to a non-null value, the value of this attribute in state will not change.

id.description: Unique id of the proxy config
plan_modifiers: stringplanmodifier.useNonNullStateForUnknown: Once set to a non-null value, the value of this attribute in state will not change.

key.description: The key of the proxy config. Changing it replaces the proxy config.
plan_modifiers: stringplanmodifier.requiresReplaceIfModifier: If the value of this attribute changes, Terraform will destroy and recreate the resource.

mapping_rules.description: Proxy config mapping rules will include the rules that will be used to map the request to the backend service by a URL and a http method. The Permit API identifies a rule by its `url` and `http_method`, so no two rules may have the same pair. When a rule leaves the list, or its `url` or `http_method` changes, the provider removes the old rule from Permit. Each create and update leaves Permit with the rules in the list's order. Terraform does not detect rules reordered outside Terraform: the state keeps the list's order, and the next update of the proxy config restores it in Permit.
validators: no two mapping rules may have the same url and http_method

mapping_rules.action.description: The key of the action on `resource` that a matching request is checked for.

mapping_rules.headers.description: Header values that a request must have to match the rule.

mapping_rules.http_method.description: The HTTP method that a request must use, in lower case: `get`, `post`, `put`, `patch`, `delete`, `head` or `options`.

mapping_rules.priority.description: The priority of the rule when more than one rule matches a request: the higher the number, the higher the precedence.

mapping_rules.resource.description: The key of the resource that a matching request acts on.

mapping_rules.url.description: The URL that a request must match, such as `https://billing.example.com/v1/invoices`, or a regular expression when `url_type` is `regex`. A placeholder in the URL, such as `{invoice_id}` in `.../invoices/{invoice_id}`, makes the Permit API add an attribute of that name to `resource`, so a `permitio_resource` that manages that resource no longer matches Permit and its next plan shows the change.

mapping_rules.url_type.description: How `url` matches the request URL. Set to `regex` to match it as a regular expression; omit it to match `url` as a URL. The API checks that `url` is a valid URL, or a valid regular expression, only when it creates the proxy config: an update stores `url` without checking it.
validators: value must be one of: ["regex"]

name.description: The name of the proxy config, for example: 'Stripe API'

organization_id.description: Unique id of the organization that owns the proxy config
plan_modifiers: stringplanmodifier.useNonNullStateForUnknown: Once set to a non-null value, the value of this attribute in state will not change.

See [our documentation](https://api.permit.io/v2/redoc#tag/Condition-Sets/operation/create_condition_set) for more information on condition sets.

conditions.description: a boolean expression that consists of multiple conditions, with and/or logic. A JSON object, such as `jsonencode({ allOf = [...] })`. Differences in whitespace and key order from the object Permit returns do not show as changes.

description.description: an optional longer description of the set. Removing it clears the description in Permit.

plan_modifiers: stringplanmodifier.requiresReplaceIfModifier: If the value of this attribute changes, Terraform will destroy and recreate the resource.

name.description: A descriptive name for the set, i.e: 'US based employees' or 'Users behind VPN'

organization_id.description: The id of the organization to which the condition set belongs.

parent_id.description: The parent condition set id. Allows creating a nested condition set hierarchy. A plan that removes it from a set that has a parent fails: the provider cannot detach a set from its parent in place. To remove it from such a set, run `terraform taint` on the set and apply: Terraform replaces the set, which deletes its condition set rules. `terraform apply -replace` fails with the same error.
plan_modifiers: conditionsets.refuseParentRemoval: Fails a plan that removes the parent of a condition set that has one.

project_id.description: The id of the project to which the condition set belongs.
plan_modifiers: stringplanmodifier.useNonNullStateForUnknown: Once set to a non-null value, the value of this attribute in state will not change.

resource.description: The resource whose instances the set selects, by key, such as `document`. Changing it to another resource replaces the set, which also deletes the condition set rules on it. Changing it between the key and the ID of the same resource updates the set in place.

permitio_role_derivation.description: Grants `to_role` on `resource` to every user who has `role` on an `on_resource` instance linked by the `linked_by` relation. For example, `role = "manager"`, `on_resource = "folder"`, `to_role = "editor"`, `resource = "file"` and `linked_by = "parent"` make folder managers editors of the files in their folders. Every argument forces replacement: changing one removes the derivation and creates a new one. See [the documentation](https://api.permit.io/v2/redoc#tag/Implicit-Grants/operation/create_implicit_grant) for more information on role derivations.

linked_by.description: The key of the relation that links `on_resource` instances to `resource` instances. A value that has the form of an ID, a UUID, fails validation.
plan_modifiers: stringplanmodifier.requiresReplaceIfModifier: If the value of this attribute changes, Terraform will destroy and recreate the resource.
validators: value must be the key of a permitio_relation, not its ID

on_resource.description: The key of the related resource that `role` belongs to. A value that has the form of an ID, a UUID, fails validation.
plan_modifiers: stringplanmodifier.requiresReplaceIfModifier: If the value of this attribute changes, Terraform will destroy and recreate the resource.

resource.description: The key of the resource that `to_role` belongs to. Users get `to_role` on instances of this resource. A value that has the form of an ID, a UUID, fails validation.
plan_modifiers: stringplanmodifier.requiresReplaceIfModifier: If the value of this attribute changes, Terraform will destroy and recreate the resource.
validators: value must be the key of a permitio_resource, not its ID

role.description: The key of a role on `on_resource`. Users who have this role on an `on_resource` instance get `to_role` on the linked `resource` instances. A value that has the form of an ID, a UUID, fails validation.
plan_modifiers: stringplanmodifier.requiresReplaceIfModifier: If the value of this attribute changes, Terraform will destroy and recreate the resource.
validators: value must be the key of a permitio_role, not its ID

plan_modifiers: stringplanmodifier.requiresReplaceIfModifier: If the value of this attribute changes, Terraform will destroy and recreate the resource.
validators: value must be the key of a permitio_role, not its ID

permitio_user_set.description: Manages a user set: a condition set that selects users by their attributes, for use in a `permitio_condition_set_rule`. See [our documentation](https://api.permit.io/v2/redoc#tag/Condition-Sets/operation/create_condition_set) for more information on condition sets.

conditions.description: a boolean expression that consists of multiple conditions, with and/or logic. A JSON object, such as `jsonencode({ allOf = [...] })`. Differences in whitespace and key order from the object Permit returns do not show as changes.

description.description: an optional longer description of the set. Removing it clears the description in Permit.

environment_id.description: The id of the environment to which the condition set belongs.
plan_modifiers: stringplanmodifier.useNonNullStateForUnknown: Once set to a non-null value, the value of this attribute in state will not change.

id.description: The ID Permit assigns to the condition set.
plan_modifiers: stringplanmodifier.useNonNullStateForUnknown: Once set to a non-null value, the value of this attribute in state will not change.

key.description: A unique id by which Permit will identify the condition set. The key will be used as the generated rego rule name. Changing it replaces the set, which also deletes the condition set rules on it.
plan_modifiers: stringplanmodifier.requiresReplaceIfModifier: If the value of this attribute changes, Terraform will destroy and recreate the resource.

name.description: A descriptive name for the set, i.e: 'US based employees' or 'Users behind VPN'

organization_id.description: The id of the organization to which the condition set belongs.
plan_modifiers: stringplanmodifier.useNonNullStateForUnknown: Once set to a non-null value, the value of this attribute in state will not change.

parent_id.description: The parent condition set id. Allows creating a nested condition set hierarchy. A plan that removes it from a set that has a parent fails: the provider cannot detach a set from its parent in place. To remove it from such a set, run `terraform taint` on the set and apply: Terraform replaces the set, which deletes its condition set rules. `terraform apply -replace` fails with the same error.
plan_modifiers: conditionsets.refuseParentRemoval: Fails a plan that removes the parent of a condition set that has one.

project_id.description: The id of the project to which the condition set belongs.
plan_modifiers: stringplanmodifier.useNonNullStateForUnknown: Once set to a non-null value, the value of this attribute in state will not change.

permitio_condition_set.description: Reads a user set or a resource set by its key, such as one that Terraform does not manage, for use in a `permitio_condition_set_rule`. Only `key` selects the set; every other attribute holds what Permit returns.

conditions.description: The conditions of the set, as a JSON object; read them with `jsondecode`. Setting it does not filter the lookup: Permit's value replaces it.

description.description: The description of the condition set, or null when it has none. Setting it does not filter the lookup: Permit's value replaces it.

environment_id.description: The ID of the environment the condition set belongs to.

id.description: The ID Permit assigns to the condition set.

key.description: The key of the user set or resource set to read.

name.description: The name of the condition set. Setting it does not filter the lookup: Permit's value replaces it.

organization_id.description: The ID of the organization the condition set belongs to.

parent_id.description: The ID of the parent condition set, if any.

project_id.description: The ID of the project the condition set belongs to.

resource.description: The key of the resource a resource set selects instances of, or null for a user set. Setting it does not filter the lookup: Permit's value replaces it.

type.description: `userset` for a user set or `resourceset` for a resource set. Setting it does not filter the lookup: Permit's value replaces it.

permitio_resource.description: Reads a resource by its key, with its actions and attributes, such as one that Terraform does not manage. Only `key` selects the resource; every other attribute holds what Permit returns.

actions.description: The actions of the resource, by action key. Setting it does not filter the lookup: Permit's value replaces it.

actions.description.description: The description of the action, or null.

actions.id.description: The ID Permit assigns to the action.

attributes.description: The attributes of the resource, by attribute key. Setting it does not filter the lookup: Permit's value replaces it.

attributes.description.description: The description of the attribute, or null.

attributes.type.description: The type of the attribute: `bool`, `number`, `string`, `time`, `array` or `json`.
validators: The type of the attribute in the resource.

description.description: The description of the resource, or null when it has none. Setting it does not filter the lookup: Permit's value replaces it.

environment_id.description: The ID of the environment the resource belongs to.

id.description: The ID Permit assigns to the resource.

key.description: The key of the resource to read.

name.description: The name of the resource. Setting it does not filter the lookup: Permit's value replaces it.

organization_id.description: The ID of the organization the resource belongs to.

project_id.description: The ID of the project the resource belongs to.

updated_at.description: When the resource was last updated.

urn.description: The URN of the resource, or null when it has none. Setting it does not filter the lookup: Permit's value replaces it.

permitio_role.description: Reads a role by its key: a top-level role, or with `resource` a role on that resource. Only `key` and `resource` select the role; every other attribute holds what Permit returns.

description.description: The description of the role, or null when it has none. Setting it does not filter the lookup: Permit's value replaces it.

environment_id.description: The ID of the environment the role belongs to.

extends.description: The keys of the roles whose permissions this role inherits. Setting it does not filter the lookup: Permit's value replaces it.

id.description: The ID Permit assigns to the role.

key.description: The key of the role to read.

name.description: The name of the role. Setting it does not filter the lookup: Permit's value replaces it.

organization_id.description: The ID of the organization the role belongs to.

permissions.description: The permissions the role grants: `resource_key:action_key` pairs for a top-level role, such as `document:read`, and action keys of `resource` for a resource role, such as `read`. Setting it does not filter the lookup: Permit's value replaces it.

project_id.description: The ID of the project the role belongs to.

resource.description: The key of the resource the role belongs to. Set it to read a resource role; leave it out to read a top-level role, and it is then null.

resource_id.description: The ID of the resource the role belongs to, or null for a top-level role.

updated_at.description: When the role was last updated.
